gaps.sentence: Several issues remain ___ (resolve) before the launch.
gaps.explanation: 'Remain' + passive infinitive (to be resolved) expresses unfinished business.

gaps.sentence: The message ___ have been misheard by the interpreter.
gaps.explanation: Perfect modal passive = modal + have been + past participle: must have been misheard.

gaps.sentence: The Eiffel Tower ___ (design) by Gustave Eiffel's engineering firm.
gaps.explanation: Past simple passive with agent: was designed by. Historical events take past simple.

gaps.sentence: All the tickets ___ (sell) within an hour of going on sale.
gaps.explanation: Past simple passive: were + sold. 'All the tickets' takes a plural verb.

gaps.sentence: The castle ___ in the twelfth century.
gaps.explanation: A completed past date takes the past simple passive.

gaps.sentence: The results ___ (publish) on the university website next Friday.
gaps.explanation: Future simple passive: will be + past participle. 'Next Friday' fixes the future reference.

gaps.sentence: The new stadium ___ by the end of the decade.
gaps.explanation: 'By the end of the decade' needs future perfect passive: will have been + completed. The stadium is completed by somebody.

gaps.sentence: Passengers ___ (ask) to fasten their seatbelts before take-off.
gaps.explanation: Present simple passive: are + asked. The agent (crew) is obvious and omitted.
